verdict.summary: Round 1's major oracle defect is fixed. The comparator now identifies expanded @json value objects, switches their @value subtree to recursively exact JSON array semantics, preserves object-member order insensitivity, and keeps ordinary JSON-LD property arrays unordered. The new witness test directly proves both top-level and nested @json array reorderings compare unequal, equal payloads still compare equal, JSON object key order remains insignificant, and the carve-out does not affect ordinary value arrays. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff. The focused test could not be executed in this environment because cargo is unavailable, but the test and implementation are internally consistent on inspection.
